label: ripgrep
when-to-use: Use first for targeted text, symbol, and file-content discovery.

label: fd
when-to-use: Use to locate files by name, extension, type, or directory.

label: jq
when-to-use: Use for precise JSON inspection, filtering, validation, and transformation.

label: yq
when-to-use: Use for precise YAML inspection, filtering, validation, and transformation.

label: ShellCheck
when-to-use: Use after shell changes to detect correctness and portability issues.

label: shfmt
description: Format shell scripts consistently with syntax-aware formatting
when-to-use: Use to check or apply consistent shell formatting after edits.

label: ast-grep
description: Search and rewrite code with syntax-aware patterns
when-to-use: Use when syntax-aware matching or a safe structural rewrite is better than text search.

label: GitHub CLI
description: Work with GitHub repositories and pull requests
when-to-use: Use for GitHub issues, pull requests, checks, releases, and repository metadata.

label: SOPS
when-to-use: Use for encrypted configuration and secret files without exposing plaintext.

label: hyperfine
when-to-use: Use to compare command performance with repeatable measurements.

label: just
description: Run project commands defined in a `justfile`
when-to-use: Use existing project recipes instead of reconstructing their commands manually.

label: Playwright CLI
description: Capture pages and automate browser workflows (requires Node.js 20+)
when-to-use: Use for browser interaction, UI flows, screenshots, and rendered-page checks.

label: Lighthouse
description: Audit web performance, accessibility, SEO, and best practices (requires Node.js 22+)
when-to-use: Use for evidence-based audits of a rendered web page.
